description: This file contains unit tests for the CredentialsObject class, verifying serialization, validation, and error handling logic related to credentials management within the org.eclipse.hono.util package.

classes.name: CredentialsObjectTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CredentialsObject, testing marshalling, validation, and error detection.

methods.name: testMarshaling
methods.description: Tests serializing CredentialsObject to JSON and back, verifying properties are correctly preserved.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingSecrets
methods.description: Ensures that CredentialsObject without secrets throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsAcceptsEmptySecrets
methods.description: Verifies that an empty set of secrets in CredentialsObject is considered valid.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMalformedNotBefore
methods.description: Checks detection of malformed 'not before' timestamp in secrets.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMalformedNotAfter
methods.description: Checks detection of malformed 'not after' timestamp in secrets.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsInconsistentValidityPeriod
methods.description: Ensures invalid validity periods are detected when 'not before' is after 'not after'.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingHashFunction
methods.description: Verifies detection of missing hash function in hashed password secrets.

methods.name: testCheckSecretsDetectsMissingHashValue
methods.description: Verifies detection of missing hash value in hashed password secrets.
